text:
## Quality Assurance  
### Screening Audit  
**Monthly Audit:**
- Review 10+ screening decisions
- Verify hits properly escalated
- Confirm false positives documented
- Assess timeliness of decisions  
**Annual Audit:**
- Full screening process review
- List coverage verification (all lists active)
- Hit resolution timeliness
- SAR filing appropriateness  
---

raw_entities.name: Screening Audit Process
raw_entities.description: A periodic quality assurance procedure comprising monthly and annual audit cycles to review screening decisions, verify escalation protocols, document false positives, assess decision timeliness, and confirm list coverage and SAR filing appropriateness.

raw_entities.name: Review Screening Decisions
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step to review 10 or more screening decisions to assess their accuracy and compliance with established procedures.

raw_entities.name: Verify Hits Escalation
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step to verify that screening hits have been properly escalated according to established protocols.

raw_entities.name: Document False Positives
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step to confirm that false positives from screening decisions are properly documented for audit trail and process improvement.

raw_entities.name: Assess Decision Timeliness
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step to evaluate whether screening decisions are being made within acceptable timeframes.

raw_entities.name: Full Screening Process Review
raw_entities.description: Annual audit step to conduct a comprehensive review of the entire screening process to identify systemic issues and process improvements.

raw_entities.name: Verify List Coverage
raw_entities.description: Annual audit step to confirm that all required screening lists are active and being applied consistently throughout the screening process.

raw_entities.name: Assess Hit Resolution Timeliness
raw_entities.description: Annual audit step to evaluate the timeliness of resolving screening hits from initial detection to final disposition.

raw_entities.name: Assess SAR Filing Appropriateness
raw_entities.description: Annual audit step to review whether Suspicious Activity Reports are being filed appropriately and in accordance with regulatory requirements.

raw_entities.name: Quality Assurance Auditor
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for conducting monthly and annual screening audits, reviewing decisions, verifying escalations, and assessing compliance with screening procedures.

raw_entities.name: Screening List Coverage Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A mandatory annual compliance gate to verify that all required screening lists are active and properly maintained as part of the AML screening control framework.

raw_entities.name: SAR Filing Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A mandatory annual compliance gate to verify that Suspicious Activity Reports are being filed appropriately and in accordance with regulatory obligations.

raw_entities.name: Screening Hit Detection and Escalation
raw_entities.description: The AML screening process that generates hits requiring escalation, resolution, and documentation as part of the bank's ongoing sanctions and PEP screening obligations.

raw_entities.name: SAR Filing Obligation
raw_entities.description: The regulatory obligation to file Suspicious Activity Reports, subject to annual audit review to ensure appropriateness and timeliness of filings.
